title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4: High-Efficiency Blackwell Optimized MoE
summary: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 is a 35B Mixture-of-Experts LLM optimized by Red Hat for the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture using 4-bit floating point quantization. It achieves significant throughput gains on RTX 50-series GPUs while preserving reasoning capabilities through its 3B active parameter sub-network.
research_notes: Native hardware acceleration requires NVIDIA Blackwell (RTX 50-series or B100); compatible with vLLM, SGLang, and Ollama.

evolution.summary: Released in April 2026, Qwen3.6 introduced 'Thinking Preservation' to maintain reasoning consistency in long dialogues and significantly improved agentic coding performance. This NVFP4 version represents the current state-of-the-art for local MoE deployment on consumer and enterprise hardware.
